text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Lyme Disease (Lyme Arthritis) with secondary Reactive Arthritis or disseminated infection. Given the Minnesota camping history, recent migratory knee pain, wrist monoarthritis, and absence of a described rash, this is highly suggestive of late-stage Lyme disease causing septic-like joint effusion. The elevated inflammatory markers from the pending CBC/ESR/CRP will confirm the systemic inflammatory response, and the RPR will rule out syphilis as a co-factor given the sexual history. I am awaiting the blood results and wrist X-ray to assess for joint space effusion or erosions before initiating doxycycline therapy.
